svyexpo: survey exposure linkage and Bayesian spatial modelling

Source: R/svyexpo-package.R
svyexpo-package.Rd

The package is organised as six modules. Each module takes and returns ordinary R objects (data frames, sf objects, SpatRasters), so any step can be used on its own or swapped for your own code.

Details

  1. Ingest – svy_standardize(), svy_from_dhs(): map survey records onto a common schema and attach cluster coordinates.

  2. Boundaries – svy_boundaries(), svy_assign_areas(): download and cache GADM polygons and assign clusters to administrative areas.

  3. Exposure linkage – svy_buffers(), svy_extract(), svy_extract_by_year(): extract raster values within displacement-aware buffers, reading only the pixels that are needed.

  4. Spatial structure – svy_adjacency(): build the neighbourhood graph, repair islands and index areas for INLA.

  5. Models – svy_fit_bym2(): BYM2 models with optional spatially varying coefficients.

  6. Outputs – svy_area_effects(), svy_svc_effects(), svy_diagnostics(), svy_map(): posterior summaries, exceedance probabilities, model diagnostics and maps.

svy_simulate() generates a small synthetic survey, boundary set and exposure raster so that every step can be run without restricted data.

Package options

  • svyexpo.cache_dir: directory used to cache GADM downloads. Defaults to a session temporary directory; set it to a permanent folder to avoid repeated downloads, e.g. options(svyexpo.cache_dir = tools::R_user_dir("svyexpo", "cache")).
